root_cause: Feature artifacts were written to canonical loadable filenames before the manifest commit. An interrupted first save could therefore be consumed as legacy-unverified, and a replacement generation was exposed file by file before its new manifest became authoritative.

repair.commit_boundary: atomic manifest replacement after every declared artifact exists
repair.no_manifest_eligibility: only pre-existing canonical bundles.json/bundles.parquet legacy names
repair.manifested_load: only declared generation paths, honoring JSON/Parquet preference
repair.path_policy: local basename only; absolute and traversal paths fail closed

historical_reconstruction.reason: The defect is a publication boundary. Existing artifacts remain preserved; only future saves use transactional generations.

promotion.reason: Crash consistency prevents false evidence but does not establish predictive superiority.

highest_value_next_action: Consolidate the repaired source/feature lineage into a versioned future-only candidate configuration, then collect untouched hash-bound batter rows alongside certified starter receipts for separate-market prospective adjudication.
